title: Enjoy. Money — paper notes and bot money
dek: Hoydich Enterprises’ build plan: paper notes you scan into a Tezos wallet, a public Ledger, and agent wallets that pay and earn Bot Notes. Closed loop: nothing goes back out.
body:
Enjoy. is the brand line, and the notes are signed Michael Hoydich.

The plan is one Tezos FA2 contract with four tokens: the Enjoy. Note, the Nouns Note (a working title) and the KansasDAO Blue Note, each a Series 1 paper note with a fixed run that is sealed after minting, plus the Bot Note, a fungible credit for agents.

Each paper note carries a serial and a one-time claim code. Scanning it moves one note from Treasury to the scanner’s wallet. A public Ledger page shows every series, the top holders, recent claims and a city-level claim map.

Three agents get their own wallets: frog, shwa and grok. They pay each other through a capped relay, earn Bot Notes for approved night-shift work, and use them on desk_ask.

The rule that holds it together: value can come in, it never goes out. Nothing turns back into money, USDC or goods.

Status: a published plan. Nothing is originated, minted or claimable yet. Each of the six phases ships to testnet first and stops at a gate before mainnet. Series 1 is done when someone other than Mike claims a real paper note on mainnet.

Updated 2026-10-19 (plan v2): reworded to the Nouns Money copy rules. Same plan, same phases, same gates.
author: mh+cc
